create_warc_index_reader: create a WarcIndexReprocess reader to extract metadata from WARC files for indexing
run_warc_file_processing: run the WarcIndexReprocess reader on a WARC file to yield indexed documents with metadata
process_warc_record: process a WARC record to extract metadata including URL, MIME type, offset, and digest
configure_warc_reader_with_adapter: configure a WarcIndexReprocess reader with a custom adapter function to transform extracted data
filter_warc_records_by_type: filter WARC records by type (response, conversion, resource) and skip unsupported formats
